evidence.quote: But now the floors appear darker with MuJoCo v3.3.3:

first_fix: Pin MuJoCo 3.3.2 in the LIBERO eval environment (pip install mujoco==3.3.2) and compare only against numbers produced with the same MuJoCo release.
healthy_controls: mujoco==3.3.2 with --task_suite_name libero_object (the LIBERO#88 / openvla#282 fix): consistent
mujoco 3.3.3 with --task_suite_name libero_spatial: not_applicable (the rendering evidence covers LIBERO-Object only; the spatial initial-state boundary is MUJOCO-GE340-LIBERO-SPATIAL-INIT-OPENVLA)
title: MuJoCo >=3.3.3 on the declared LIBERO-Object evaluation differs from the floor rendering reported for the original data; compare results only under a matched simulator; the open-ended threshold is a prospective risk warning, not verification of every later release
unknown_when: Supply the complete selected stacks, one unambiguous applicable evaluation command and an exact MuJoCo release. This entry covers only the literal single-suite command; comma-separated, reordered or alternate suite encodings are outside its declared scope. Missing or repeated flags, ambiguous shell text, absent/conflicting versions remain UNKNOWN. Metadata does not attest execution. The threshold extrapolates the cited measured deviation as a prospective WARNING; arbitrary future release behavior has not been reproduced or source-proven.
